sources.mdb_deaths: WHO Mortality Database ICD-10 (detailed List 104/103/10M, national rows), cdn.who.int/.../mortality-raw-data/
sources.ghe_deaths: WHO GHE 2021 country deaths by cause/age/sex, cdn.who.int/.../global-health-estimates/ghe2021_deaths_bycountry_*.xlsx
sources.life_tables: WHO GHO GHE 2021 life tables (LIFE_* OData indicators), all countries

notes: MDB fine-age cause split is the default; GHE coarse split is the fallback for countries without recent detailed registration. Survival from WHO life tables; garbage codes redistributed; cause bands capped at 85+.
